About

The person behind the pixels

Drag me — I am loose on purpose

Every card on this page that floats can be picked up and moved. The page is a desk, not a poster.

A student designer who thinks deeply before he draws anything.

I am Sharma Somritjoy Deb — a designer and illustrator working across brand marks, channel art, posters and full websites. My days go into Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and Premiere Pro, and my standard is simple: if it does not mean something, it does not ship.

This site is my 2026 portfolio. Every photo of me here has its background lifted clean away — no frame, no box. The face, the expression and the clothes are exactly as photographed, only freshened a touch: clearer, brighter, lightly sharpened. The same person you will meet when we work together.

“Whether I’m designing a logo, illustrating a poster, or laying out a website — I love the process of thinking deeply and creating something that means something.”

How every piece gets made

The same four steps, whether it is a single logo or the full set.

STEP 01

Brief

You tell me what it is for, who should stop scrolling, and what it must say.

STEP 02

Design

I think first, then draw — type, colour and layout built around that one message.

STEP 03

Finish

Edges cleaned, contrast checked, every size from phone to billboard tested.

STEP 04

Deliver

Final files sent clean and ready to post, print or publish.

Questions

Before you write to me

What do you design?+

Logos and monograms, YouTube banners and channel art, Facebook posters and posts, and complete website designs — single pieces or a full matching brand set like my Portfolio 2026.

How do we start a project?+

Message me on Telegram at @sjoy1234567, or use the form below — it copies your message and opens Telegram with everything ready. Tell me what the piece is for and who it should reach.

Can one design work everywhere?+

Yes — that is the point of the Finish step. Every piece is checked at phone size and at full size before it is delivered, so the same design holds up as a thumbnail and as a poster.
